name: Rocket Propulsion
description: This course provides an in-depth study of the fundamentals of rocket propulsion, covering topics such as propulsion theory, engine types, and performance analysis.

name: Aerodynamics
description: This course offers a comprehensive exploration of aerodynamics, focusing on the principles and applications of airflow and its effects on structures and vehicles.

name: Spacecraft Design
description: This course delves into the principles and methodologies of spacecraft design, bringing together concepts from engineering, physics, and technology.

name: Organic Chemistry
description: Organic Chemistry is an in-depth study of the structure, properties, and reactions of organic compounds and organic materials.

name: Inorganic Chemistry
description: Inorganic Chemistry focuses on the properties, structures, and behaviors of inorganic and organometallic compounds.

name: Physical Chemistry
description: Physical Chemistry combines the principles of physics and chemistry to understand the physical properties of molecules and how chemical reactions occur.

name: Ancient Languages
description: This course provides an introduction to various ancient languages, exploring their historical and cultural significance.
